397	+def parse_cds_fasta(path: Optional[Path]) -> Dict[str, List[Tuple[str, str]]]:
398	+    """Index cds.fna by NUCLEOTIDE accession -- not protein accession.
399	+
400	+    Unlike protein.faa (keyed by protein accessionVersion), cds.fna's defline carries the
401	+    parent nucleotide accession plus a coordinate suffix (e.g. 'PX492530.1:1-430'),
402	+    because a CDS is a coordinate range on its parent nucleotide record. A single
403	+    nucleotide accession can carry more than one CDS -- 134 in this package, mostly
404	+    ambisense S segments encoding both N and NSs on overlapping reading frames, plus a
405	+    few M segments annotated with separate G1/G2 CDS alongside a combined precursor
406	+    entry. parse_fasta's setdefault-first-wins index would silently keep whichever CDS
407	+    happened to be read first and drop the other, so this keeps every distinct
408	+    (product, sequence) pair per accession and leaves selection to select_primary_cds.
409	+    """

413	+        if not desc:
